summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Starving Artists multiplayer board game. Backend APIs (19/21 tests passed - 90%), Frontend UI fully functional with all game elements rendering correctly.

minor.issue: When player joins via API, lobby UI doesn't update in real-time without page refresh. Socket event not emitted from HTTP endpoint.

integration_issues.issue: Player list doesn't update in real-time when new player joins via API. Requires page refresh to see new players.

action_items: Emit Socket.IO event from lobby.routes.ts when player joins via POST /lobby/join/:gameId to enable real-time lobby updates
critical_code_review_comments: Missing rules.ejs and about.ejs templates cause 500 errors on /rules and /about routes
Socket.IO integration in lobby routes should emit events to notify connected clients when players join/leave via HTTP API

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI elements render correctly, game flow works)

seed_data_creation: Tests create games dynamically using in-memory database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses in-memory database (memoryDb.ts) instead of MySQL. Server runs on port 8001. Session cookies required for authenticated endpoints. Game flow: create game -> join lobby -> start game (2+ players) -> play turns. Socket.IO used for real-time updates but HTTP endpoints don't emit socket events.
